purpose: The ONE shared golden set for OPENBOT_CRAFT_PREVIEW_ORIGIN_TEMPLATE: the same template must get the same open/closed/derived verdict from the server's parseTemplate (server/src/craft/preview-origin.ts) and the sidecar's derive_preview_host (docker/compose/certs/lib.sh). Read by BOTH suites — server/tests/craft-preview-origin.test.ts (the server face) and scripts/tls-pipeline.test.ts (the sidecar face) — so a tightening on either face must update this file, and this file only, to keep the two faces locked in step. Before #415 each face carried its own inline golden list and the lockstep was enforced by cross-referencing comments alone; the ticket's cross cases (a `*` the server once served, a `..` the sidecar once certified) fell exactly in that seam.

server.open: admission().ok is true; `derived` (when present) is the address originFor mints, with the 20-hex session label spelled {label}
server.closed: admission().ok is false with a reason naming OPENBOT_CRAFT_PREVIEW_ORIGIN_TEMPLATE; originFor throws

sidecar.ok: lib.sh __derive exits 0 and prints `ok|<scheme>|<baseHostname>`; `derived` pins that exact line
sidecar.skip: lib.sh __derive exits 0 and prints `skip|<reason>`; `reasonContains` pins the reason

cases.note: The dev form (D5): no wildcard certificate exists to derive on either face.
#415 ticket case: `*` parses as a WHATWG hostname, so the server needed its own explicit refusal; the sidecar's base charset never admitted it. Neither face serves it.
#415 ticket case (`preview..example.com`): empty interior labels mint degenerate wildcards; fix-ocr27 #2 refused the server face, #415 the sidecar face.
WHATWG domain-to-ASCII accepts a boundary hyphen (fix-ocr19 #9 measured it), so both faces serve it — pinned so a future tightening stays two-faced.
IDN must be configured punycode (xn--): a unicode SAN never matches the wire; the certificate pipeline sees the ASCII form only.
Port 0 has no serving meaning; refused on both faces since fix-ocr26 #9.
WHATWG's port range ends at 65535; the divergence class fix-ocr18 #8 closed.

RECORDED DIVERGENCE (harmless by construction): the server serves the local testing form; no public CA can issue for the reserved .localhost domain, so the sidecar skips rather than crash-looping (fix-ocr18 #9).

RECORDED DIVERGENCE (harmless, pinned on preview-origin.ts:623): the server refuses a single-label base — it would claim an entire public suffix — while the sidecar stays laxer (LE refuses to issue for a bare public suffix anyway).
The preview pass cookie is SameSite=None; Secure — a plain-http origin can never accept it (fix-ocr4 #9 / fix-ocr18 #9, both faces).
